validation.renderer: Fixed-camera direct Three.js diagnostic with SwiftShader, physical glass and SSAO; not Kite3D lifecycle validation or a production performance budget
validation.localScriptTests: 9 passed, including retained-wall normal orientation after manually observed shadow acne
validation.githubCI: not used; no pushes after instruction
validation.bufferChecks: Both assets: finite accessors, valid byte bounds and index ranges
validation.editorLifecycle: Passed in isolated fixture: camera/environment restoration, save, full city regeneration, owner edit retention, reload, repeated and interrupted Play cleanup
validation.comparison: Independent inspection finds threshold contact, grille occlusion and adjacent canopy closer without obvious collision. Pale step edges remain prominent; whole-image gaps remain uniform glazing, sparse small detail, simplified upper molding and clean repeated surfaces.
validation.latestFlow: Passed local offset-camera inspection, shadow-follow and Stop-listener cleanup, owner-edit preservation through full regeneration, reload, repeated Play/Stop and interrupted Play cleanup after threshold and canopy corrections.

shadowDiagnosis.cause: Retained footprint wall triangles faced inward; double-sided materials hid the winding error while shadow normal bias displaced samples into solid geometry
shadowDiagnosis.controls: Normal-map removal did not help; received-shadow disable removed the pattern; corrected winding with cast shadows enabled removed the pattern
shadowDiagnosis.fix: Orient retained walls away from solid volume, including holes. Focus the runtime shadow map around camera target at street scale and remove tracking listener on Stop.

validation.glassShadowDiagnosis: Generated fully transmissive panes were casting opaque depth-map shadows onto recessed interiors. Clear transmission >= 0.95 runtime batches now omit shadow casting; authored materials and scene stay unchanged. No refractive caustics claimed.

lightingStudy.method: Fixed camera, unchanged geometry within each comparison. Sun color, exposure and environment control varied separately in unsaved browser diagnostics.
lightingStudy.observed: Neutral sun removes the strong yellow cast and is adopted. Exposure 1.2 brightens road/trim without resolving interiors and is rejected. Material envMapIntensity test was ineffective because scene intensity takes precedence. Corrected scene environment intensity 1.7 visibly washes glazing and is rejected; original intensity/exposure retained.
lightingStudy.limitation: Software renderer and authored HDR environment; not captured illumination or a production performance measurement.
lightingStudy.independentCritique: Independent pixel review agrees: neutral sun preferred; exposure increase and environment 1.7 rejected. Global lighting is secondary to missing local reflections, layered contents and architectural variation.

reflectionStudy.controls: Unsaved fixed-camera black-dielectric control isolates reflection from shop transmission. Original neutral sun/exposure/environment intensity retained.
reflectionStudy.changes: Rear walls moved from 2.2m to 4.8m; partitions set back 0.9m; physical shelves/stock placed 0.5-0.7m behind glass after deep stock proved occluded. Original inferred reflected street extends to +/-144m rather than +/-36m to cover grazing rays.
reflectionStudy.limits: Environment and merchandise inferred, not captured/observed business assets. No reflection cards. No increase in HDR dimensions or runtime light count. Near-window repositioning makes some stock visible but improvement remains modest, not photographic realism.

representativeWindow.reference: Turquoise shop in Figure 128, image x~39-196; main verticals selected at x~84 and144 of566 pixels
representativeWindow.projection: At fixed camera, facade local x0.8 projects to83.47px andx2.4 to143.95px; prior mullions were roughly96 and151px
representativeWindow.changes: Central glazed entrance replaces continuous tiled bulkhead; real painted-metal grille with rail/finial geometry; side display shelving near glass rather than across door
representativeWindow.uncertainty: Pixel picks and hidden joinery estimated. Original inferred merchandise and lettering, not identified business products.
representativeWindow.independentCritique: Entrance opening, corrected mullions and side-only displays materially closer structurally. Initial grille too dominant; reduced bar width/height and assigned painted metal, with close-glass stock and smaller left-pane lettering.
representativeWindow.finalCritique: Independent final inspection: materially closer entrance structure, thinner/shorter grille less dominant and near-glass stock more readable. Still sparse, grille unusually exposed compared with photograph; no major regression.
representativeWindow.threshold: Photo-estimated shop floor raised0.29m with two0.145m steps; grille base atlocaly0.45 projects near365.6px atx0.9 instead385.2px atpreviousy0.18. Not surveyed.

validation.adjacentEntrance: Burgundy canopy radius0.85m and centerx5.145 replace1.05m/5.5m; paired doors recentered. Independent comparison places canopy aroundx36-48%,y43-59% versus photo35-50%,42-60%.

glazingControl.comparison: Fixed camera, neutral sunlight, original exposure and environment intensity. Generated clear glass roughness 0.004 versus 0.035.
glazingControl.result: Keep 0.004. Softer glass blurs merchandise without resolving repeated reflection shapes or sparse interiors. Diagnostic only; no saved scene or material change.
glazingControl.lifecycle: Both captures completed; camera shadow tracking and Stop listener cleanup passed.

timberProfileStudy.method: Original stepped timber casing rings and multi-step bay-floor molding inferred from Figure 128. Camera and fitted opening bounds preserved.
timberProfileStudy.cost: 976 additional triangles; 76224 additional geometry bytes versus prior baseline.
timberProfileStudy.checks: Offline regeneration and 9 established local tests pass. Final full-camera render inspected after reducing excessive molding stripes; camera shadow tracking and Stop listener cleanup pass.
timberProfileStudy.review: Independent visual review found casings improved fine edges, but first multi-step bay molding made excessive dark stripes. Simplified its profile and reduced projection before final capture.

fit.method: Nonlinear least squares over camera position, yaw, field of view, vertical lens shift and shop width. Six points on facade plane, including one extrapolated cut-off base point. Not independent validation or survey calibration.
fit.uncertainty: Single view has scale and camera ambiguity. Pixel selections approximate. Facade plane fit does not establish bay, roof or streetscape agreement.

bayLandmarksNote: Four outer-left lower cornice points initially held out of camera fitting. Initial errors approximately 1.5, 15, 9.6 and 4.7 pixels. Then used to refine individual bay positions and base heights; these are no longer independent validation points.
